verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Phaser as a JS/TS framework with an optional visual Scene Editor and MCP agent tooling, but nothing addresses whether scene files are diffable/mergeable text formats, git-friendly project structure, or built-in multi-user collaboration features for studio teams. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scene/project file format (JSON vs binary), diff/merge behavior in VCS, and any built-in team collaboration or conflict-resolution tooling.
